name: font attr host eval
command: cd /home/davr/.config/dendritic && echo "--- self.fonts.marathon ---" && nix eval --impure --json --expr 'let f = builtins.getFlake "git+file:///home/davr/.config/dendritic"; in builtins.map (p: p.name) f.fonts.marathon' 2>&1 | tail -2 && echo "--- NIXPC HM home.packages fonts ---" && nix eval --impure --json --expr 'let f = builtins.getFlake "git+file:///home/davr/.config/dendritic"; c = f.nixosConfigurations.NIXPC.config; u = builtins.head (builtins.attrNames c.home-manager.users); ps = builtins.map (p: p.name) c.home-manager.users.${u}.home.packages; in builtins.filter (n: builtins.match ".*(oswald|jetbrains-mono|orbitron|source-serif).*" n != null) ps' 2>&1 | tail -2 && echo "--- fontconfig enable ---" && nix eval --impure --json --expr 'let f = builtins.getFlake "git+file:///home/davr/.config/dendritic"; c = f.nixosConfigurations.NIXPC.config; u = builtins.head (builtins.attrNames c.home-manager.users); in c.home-manager.users.${u}.fonts.fontconfig.enable' 2>&1 | tail -1
